subject: Emergency capacity + SOW adjustment — Peregrine Labs (order form revision)
messages:
From: Nicole Atkinson <nicole@peregrinelabs.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, procure@peregrinelabs.com
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Emergency capacity add + SOW tweak (August Alpha rollout)

Hi Mateo,

Quick one — we kicked off our Alpha for the August integration and usage spiked unexpectedly. We’re bumping against the committed throughput tiers and need an immediate add (estimate +60% token throughput for 6 weeks) while we complete model caching improvements on our side.

Can Redwood provide a short-term change order to add the capacity (surge pool) and a small SOW edit so the implementation window captures a minor integration task? Procurement asked me to get a commercial sketch and the right contact for legal redlines. I’ve attached a short summary with our usage graphs.

Desired outcome:
- Temporary capacity surge (60% of current committed tokens) for 6 weeks starting 9/15
- Prorated billing and a line in the order form for the surcharge and start/stop dates
- SOW paragraph adding a small integration task (5 days of Redwood eng time) with delivery acceptance criteria

I appreciate a quick confirmation of the right path — if we can get a signed change order by next Friday our engineering team can proceed without pausing the rollout.

Thanks,
Nicole Atkinson
Head of Integrations, Peregrine Labs
procurement: procure@peregrinelabs.com
Attachment: Peregrine_requested_change_summary.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Nicole — thanks for the summary and the usage file.

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
- Karthik to propose a temporary surge pricing band and a proration calculation.
- Legal to produce a short change order (Order Form amendment + 1 paragraph SOW edit) with tracked redlines for fast review.
- Finance to confirm invoicing schedule and whether an upfront invoice (partial) is required to meet accounting timelines.

Karthik — can you put a quick sketch on numbers? Mina — can you take an initial look at scope language and whether we need any DPA/DPA appendix updates for the surge? Laura — any constraints on mid-month/prorated charges for this type of amendment?

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Atkinson <nicole@peregrinelabs.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Emergency capacity add + SOW tweak (commercial sketch)

Nicole / team — draft commercial approach below. Happy to adjust.

On Sun, 12 Sep 2027 at 13:02, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’m looping in Karthik (sales lead) to propose the commercial approach and Laura (finance) + Mina from legal to handle the redlines for the Order Form / SOW.

Commercial sketch (provisional):
- Temporary surge pool: +60% of Peregrine’s committed tokens (baseline: 150M tokens/mo) => additional 90M tokens capacity
- Duration: 6 weeks (2027-09-15 through 2027-10-27)
- Rate: 1.15x the committed token unit price (applies to tokens consumed from the surge pool)
- Proration: charge calculated on actual consumption during the surge window; invoiced on next monthly invoice with a line item for the surge and reference to change order
- Cap: maximum invoice exposure for surge set to 120% of projected surge spend (need confirmation if acceptable)
- Implementation: no infra change on Redwood side beyond capacity reservation; SOW add: 5 engineering days to add config for prefix caching and rollout monitoring, acceptance sign-off by Peregrine product lead.

Requireables before we draft legal:
- Nicole to confirm baseline committed tokens (150M above is approximate from attached graph)
- Confirmation on start date 2027-09-15
- Confirmation on cap and whether they want an upfront deposit to guarantee capacity (we can propose a 30% deposit of estimated surge cost)

I’ll draft a one-page commercial summary and send to legal for redlines as soon as we have the baseline and start date.

-karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Nicole Atkinson <nicole@peregrinelabs.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Emergency capacity add + SOW tweak (legal redlines attached)

Team / Nicole — attaching redlines for the Order Form (attached PDF with tracked comments) and a redlined SOW (docx). Highlights and required decisions:

1) Order Form:
- Added a temporary line item for "Surge Capacity — Temporary Allocation" with start/end dates and the 1.15x rate.
- Proration language — we default to actual consumption; if Peregrine prefers a fixed pre-paid bucket we can add an alternative clause (see section 3 comments).
- Billing: added explicit invoicing timeline and statement that surge charges will appear on the next invoice following the surge window.
- Liability / SLA: added a short carveout that surge capacity is best-effort for the temporary window (no new SLA commitments).

2) SOW:
- Inserted a 5-day engineering task (integration: prefix cache tuning + rollout monitoring) with acceptance criteria.
- Added a delivery window aligned to the surge timeline and an explicit change acceptance sign-off by Peregrine product lead.

3) DPA / Data flow:
- No new data flows; existing DPA covers logs. Still flagged a comment to confirm Peregrine’s retention expectations during the surge.

4) Signatures and approvals:
- Suggested streamlined approval path: AE sign-off + Customer countersignature. Legal recommends we keep the Order Form amendment in the same doc and avoid a separate MSA change if possible to speed execution.

Attachments:
- ML-Inference_OrderForm_REDLINE_v1.pdf (pdf) — tracked comments visible
- SOW_v3_redline.docx (docx) — redline of SOW with inserted paragraph

Open items for the customer:
- Confirm baseline committed tokens (150M)
- Decide on cap vs pre-pay deposit option
- Confirm acceptance signatory (who will sign on behalf of Peregrine)

If the customer confirms baseline and signatory by EOD Thursday we can issue a final clean Order Form amendment and route DocuSign.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: ML-Inference_OrderForm_REDLINE_v1.pdf (pdf); SOW_v3_redline.docx (docx)
From: Nicole Atkinson <nicole@peregrinelabs.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Emergency capacity add + SOW tweak (signed and next steps)

Thanks all — we reviewed the redlines internally. Short answers: baseline is 148.5M tokens/mo (close to your 150M estimate), start date confirmed 2027-09-15, Peregrine accepts the 1.15x surge rate and prefers proration by consumption (no pre-pay). Procurement authorizes up to the 120% cap.
